critical_code_review_comments: routes/relist.py L116: admin (role in admin/superadmin) bypasses ownership check on relist — INTENTIONAL admin override per the module docstring. Non-admin non-owner gets 403 as expected. Test expectations updated to reflect this design.

routes/listings.py get_listing (~L910) does Listing(**listing_doc) without a try/except → any DB doc missing required Pydantic fields (condition, location) causes a 500 ASGI ExceptionGroup. Not exploitable in prod because real listings are always created via the validated POST, but a defensive 500→422 + structured error message + skipping legacy/incomplete docs would harden the endpoint. Low priority; cosmetic.
